summary: Both halves show p.475. The page introduces pointed L-bullet/L_pt and its inclusion in completed L. The bullet superscripts, arrows and Gamma/caret additions are hand-filled, while diagram objects and other label characters are typed. And, co, in U(k)-bullet, and X are typed interlinear additions. The isolated typed X and Y below the topology line remain without an inferred role. The last line objects in U(k) is x-struck and then hand-crossed, although the witness prints it.

edits.reason: And above compatible uses the typewriter face and is an interlinear typed addition.
The co prefix above augmentations is typed, not handwritten.
In U(k) is typewritten above in terms; its bullet is independently hand-filled and marked in the symbol pass.
The X above of U(k) has typewriter serifs and is inserted with a pen connector.
The pen stroke near the final s of augmentations is not distinct from the underline and following x cancellation; retain the proposed s deletion as uncertain rather than certify its extent.
The dark deletion before L-bullet(X) includes a right-hand t-like stem; X is not secure, so retain both X and it as unresolved alternatives.
